import asyncio


# CASE p_comment_inside_gather_call expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items: list, width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            # one barrier per chunk
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE p_apostrophe_comment_in_params expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(
    items: list,  # can't be a generator
    width: int,
    operation,
) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))
